statistics_definition: nearest-rank quantiles; median is p50 (lower middle for even sample counts)
budget_comparison: every complete CPU scope must be at or below budget; known over-budget work fails even when acceptance is incomplete
scope: whole synchronous CPU frame scopes plus exact draw/present associations
cpu_work_definition: Complete event end-start includes callbacks, draw, submission and cleanup; split initial draw and submission remain separately measured, idle gaps are not CPU work
errors: complete scope 0 draw has no matched Draw/Present events
complete scope 1 draw has no matched Draw/Present events

metadata.build_identity_note: runtime Git state is not binary provenance; build commit and binary hash must be recorded by the external build runner
metadata.backend: native GPUI; concrete renderer not exposed by FrameTimingCollector
metadata.scenario_coverage: startup and naturally scheduled frames only; interaction matrix not automated
metadata.workload: gallery startup and naturally requested frames; no synthetic refresh, no warm-up exclusion
metadata.gpu_measurement: unavailable: Present measures CPU platform submission, not GPU execution
metadata.ring_overflow_policy: full batch is incomplete, even if no loss can be proven

window.snapshot: initial window; viewport changes are not tracked
